A friend in need, is a friend indeed

Once upon a time two friends went on a journey. They had to go through a forest on the way. As they went to the wood they saw a bear coming towards them. They both were scared. One friend climbed on to a tree. He didn't even tried to save his friend. The other friend was helpless. Suddenly an ide came to his mind. He once heard that bear doesn't eat dead people. so, he laid flat on the ground without breath

The other friend watched from the tree, but he couldn't understanding anything. The bear came and sniffed his body.

After some times the bear went away. The friend who was on the tree went down. He asked the friend what the bear had told him. The friend replied that the bear had given him a good piece of ad advise. The friend was confused and asked him what was the piece advise the bear s gave him

The friend replied, "A friend in need, is a friend in deed."

answers.transcript: The Annual Prize-Giving Day of our school was held on 29th January. It was held on our school campus. The school compound was brightly decorated with flowers, balloons, coloured papers etc. It was looking very amazing and colourful. A stage was placed before in front of the school building and there were chairs and tables for the guests and students. The ceremony just began at 4 p.m. Everyone was very excited about the program. The program started with recitation from the Holy Quran. My friend recited there. Then the national anthem was sung by all. Our principal welcomed all the guests, guardians and students for coming to the program. There were many eminent person as our chief guest. At 4:30 pm our chief guest came. we welcomed him warmly. The honourable VC of BUET was our chief guest. He gave us a very motivating speech. After the speech, the prize giving ceremony began. I was very happy as I got two prizes - one for good result and one for sports. The chief guest thanked the prize winners warmly and praised the school's overall performance. After the formal meeting ended, we hosted a cultural program to entertain all of our guests. We performed dance, dramas, comedy, jokes etc. All the guests liked it very much. Before the program ended the principal thanked the chief guest for coming. At last, a concluding song was sang by the students of the school. We will never forget this day.
answers.student_title: Annual Prize-Giving Day of Our School
